content: Riya Mukherjee discusses her insurance renewal quote with agent Anjali Desai. Riya expresses confusion and concern over the higher premium compared to last year. Anjali explains that the increase is driven by new healthcare regulations and inflation, which introduced additional coverage requirements. Anjali offers to send a detailed breakdown of the changes, and Riya asks if there are any options to reduce the premium due to being on a tight budget.

action_items: Send a detailed breakdown of regulatory coverage changes
Discuss options to reduce the premium
